test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. **

Gut Feeling

options.text: To have a dispute with someone
A personal intuition you get, especially when feel something may not be right
Very excited and/or joyful, especially when in love

solution:
The correct answer is: **A personal intuition you get, especially when you feel something may not be right**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Gut feeling**" is an idiom that refers to a strong intuition or instinct about something (किसी चीज़ के बारे में एक मजबूत अंतर्ज्ञान को संदर्भित करना).
 
• This intuition is often based on subconscious cues or past experiences.
 
• It is important to listen to your gut feeling, as it can help you make better decisions.
 
 
• **Example**: "*I had a gut feeling that something wasn't right about the deal, so I decided not to invest.*"
 
 

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.
